## Change History

_Detailed change log for this standard. Include all significant modifications, updates, and revisions._

| Date       | Version | Author        | Description               | Impact              |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------- |
| YYYY-MM-DD | 1.0.0   | [Author Name] | Initial standard creation | New standard        |
| YYYY-MM-DD | 1.1.0   | [Author Name] | [Description of changes]  | [Compliance impact] |

**Change Entry Guidelines:**

- **Date**: Use YYYY-MM-DD format
- **Version**: Follow semantic versioning (major.minor.patch)
- **Author**: Full name or identifier of person making change
- **Description**: Detailed explanation of what changed and why
- **Impact**: Specify compliance impact and any migration requirements

- **Comments**: Key feedback, recommendations, or concerns raised
- **Actions**: Any follow-up actions, changes required, or next steps

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/standard.md#template-usage-instructions]

## Template Usage Instructions

1. **Copy this template** to create a new standard document
2. **Replace all bracketed placeholders** with actual content
3. **Remove template instructions** before publishing
4. **Follow the directory and naming convention**:
    - Directory: `standards/[standard-type]/`
    - Filename: `[category]-[standard-type]-standard.md`
    - Standard ID: `STD-[CATEGORY]-[TYPE]-[NNN]`
    - Example: `standards/[your-standard]/application-[your-standard]-standard.md`
5. **Generate a unique standard ID** following the convention: `STD-{CATEGORY}-{TYPE}-{NNN}`
6. **Complete all required sections** before submitting for review
7. **Include appropriate diagrams** and technical specifications
8. **Validate against quality checklist** before submission

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/standard.md#quality-checklist]

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] All metadata fields completed
- [ ] Executive summary clearly states purpose and scope
- [ ] Standard requirements are specific and measurable
- [ ] Technical specifications are detailed and implementable
- [ ] Implementation guidelines are actionable and complete
- [ ] Compliance criteria are objective and verifiable
- [ ] Examples demonstrate real-world application
- [ ] Related standards and references are accurate and relevant
- [ ] Change history section is complete with initial entry
- [ ] Review log section is present and properly formatted
- [ ] Document follows markdown formatting standards
- [ ] Content is clear, enforceable, and technically accurate
- [ ] Standard has been reviewed by relevant stakeholders
